Debug.Name: Debug Logging
Debug.Hint: Output additional debug information to the console

CloseCombatTracker.Name: Close Combat Tracker
CloseCombatTracker.Hint: Prevent the standard combat tracker from opening automatically

Scale.Name: Bar Size
Scale.Hint: Adjust the size of the token bar

PartyOnlySelf.Name: Show Only Owned Tokens
PartyOnlySelf.Hint: When not a GM, show only tokens for actors you own

QuickLoot.Name: Quick Loot
QuickLoot.Hint: Automatically transfer defeated NPC loot and open the Loot actor on combat end.

AwardXPOnEncounterEnd.Name: Offer XP Award on Encounter End
AwardXPOnEncounterEnd.Hint: Opens the XP award dialog after ending an encounter from the token bar.

ZeroHpInitiativePrompt.Name: Prompt Initiative Change at 0 HP
ZeroHpInitiativePrompt.Hint: When a party member drops to 0 HP, ask to move them just before the attacker in initiative and allow entering a custom value.

AutoNpcInitiative.Name: Auto Roll NPC Initiative
AutoNpcInitiative.Hint: Automatically roll initiative for NPCs when needed.

EncounterModeAvailable.Name: Encounter Mode Available
EncounterModeAvailable.Hint: Allow use of encounter mode features and show the encounter toggle

EncounterMode.Name: Enable Encounter Mode
EncounterMode.Hint: Use encounter features such as combatant tokens, round counter, and difficulty display. Hidden combatants are only shown to GMs.

EncounterScroll.Name: Encounter scrollbar
EncounterScroll.Hint: When disabled, the bar extends to the right without scrolling

AutoFortification.Name: Auto Fortification
AutoFortification.Hint: Automatically prompt a Fortification flat check on critical hits

AutoShadow.Name: Auto Shadow
AutoShadow.Hint: Automatically apply Shadow rune bonuses to Stealth

AutoKeen.Name: Auto Keen
AutoKeen.Hint: Automatically upgrade natural 19 attack rolls to critical hits when wielding a Keen rune

RemasterSheetMode.Name: Remaster Sheets
RemasterSheetMode.Hint: Enable alternative color schemes for character and NPC sheets

Enabled.Name: Enable Encounter Turn Assistant
Enabled.Hint: Show action resources and turn notes for the active combatant.

AutoActions.Name: Enable Automatic Action Tracking
AutoActions.Hint: Track explicitly identified PF2e action activities from chat messages.

AutoReactions.Name: Enable Automatic Reaction Tracking
AutoReactions.Hint: Track explicitly identified PF2e reactions, including outside the actor’s turn.

ShowWarnings.Name: Show Turn Warnings
ShowWarnings.Hint: Show important PF2e conditions without automating their rules.

ShowHistory.Name: Show Action History
ShowHistory.Hint: Show the most recent tracked or manual resource change.

TrackingMode.Name: Tracking Mode
TrackingMode.Hint: Conservative tracks only certain events; Automatic also tracks high-confidence events.

AutomaticMovementTracking.Name: Enable Automatic Token Movement Tracking
AutomaticMovementTracking.Hint: Spend one action after the active combatant completes a continuous token movement.

OnlyTrackActiveCombatant.Name: Only Track Active Combatant
OnlyTrackActiveCombatant.Hint: Ignore implicit token movement by combatants whose turn is not active.

IgnoreGMMovementOfPlayerTokens.Name: Ignore GM Movement of Player Tokens
IgnoreGMMovementOfPlayerTokens.Hint: Do not spend actions when a GM repositions a player-owned actor; active NPC movement is still tracked.

MovementDetectionDelay.Name: Movement Detection Delay (ms)
MovementDetectionDelay.Hint: Time without position updates before a continuous movement is considered complete.

MovementIntentTimeout.Name: Movement Intent Timeout (ms)
MovementIntentTimeout.Hint: How long a paid PF2e movement activity can suppress the following implicit movement cost.
